error.naoAssinadaTitle: Prescription has not yet been signed.
error.naoAssinadaMsg: The professional generated the link before signing the prescription. Ask them to resend it after signing.
error.revogadoMsg: This prescription was re-signed and this link has been invalidated. Ask the professional for the updated link.
error.expiradoMsg: This link is valid for 90 days and has already expired. Ask the professional for a new one.
error.tokenInvalidoMsg: The link appears to be corrupted or incomplete. Check that you copied it in full.
error.naoEncontradaMsg: Check whether the link is correct.
error.verificarMsg: Try again in a few minutes.

modal.title: Record dispense
modal.sub: Fill in the professional details and the quantity dispensed now. The record is audited and visible to the next pharmacy that fills this prescription.
modal.savePharmacy: Save CRF, CNPJ and pharmacy name in this browser (future dispenses become faster)
modal.clearSaved: Clear data saved in this browser

info:
For the pharmacy: before dispensing, record the dispense above. The system tracks the remaining balance across every pharmacy that fills this prescription. Also validate the PDF digital signature at Verificador ITI gov.br or Adobe Reader (ICP-Brasil chain).
Quick guide for pharmacists →
footer: This verification page is generated by Espaço Prelúdio in real time, querying the original prescription record. If you have any doubts about the clinical content, contact the issuing professional.
